clusters.name: After grandfather's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around the time your grandfather died in July 1989, your mother's anxiety rose over money and she stopped talking with your father about it. Within months, your brother's grades fell. Your mother calmed down once back at work by early 1990.

clusters.name: After your mother's cancer diagnosis, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: Within months of leaving home for college in September 1993, you developed migraines that kept you in bed by early 1994 and reached out to your brother most nights. Your mother was diagnosed with breast cancer in February 1995. Over the next year you pulled away from your brother and stopped calling home.
clusters.change: The run caught both your trouble and your mother's diagnosis. The period opens with you leaving home; your symptoms rose, you moved toward your brother, then away from him and from your mother around the time of her diagnosis.
